description_en: Queries the information about an automatic resource group transfer rule
description_zh: 调用GetAutoGroupingRule查询自动转组规则信息
name: GetAutoGroupingRule

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the rule was created, in RFC 3339 format with a UTC offset of +08:00
CreateTime.description_zh: 规则创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 时间格式，包含 +08:00 的 UTC 偏移

ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_en: The excluded region IDs. Multiple region IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_zh: 地域ID排除范围，多个地域ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The excluded resource group IDs. Multiple resource group IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 资源组ID排除范围，多个资源组ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_en: The excluded resource IDs. Multiple resource IDs are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 资源ID排除范围，多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceTypesScope.description_en: The excluded resource types. Multiple resource types are separated by commas (,)
ExcludeResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 资源类型排除范围，多个资源类型用半角逗号（,）分隔

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the rule was last modified, in RFC 3339 format with a UTC offset of +08:00
ModifyTime.description_zh: 规则修改时间，采用 RFC 3339 时间格式，包含 +08:00 的 UTC 偏移

RegionIdsScope.description_en: The region IDs in scope. Multiple region IDs are separated by commas (,)
RegionIdsScope.description_zh: 地域ID范围，多个地域ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The resource group IDs in scope. Multiple resource group IDs are separated by commas (,)
ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 资源组ID范围，多个资源组ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ResourceIdsScope.description_en: The resource IDs in scope. Multiple resource IDs are separated by commas (,)
ResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 资源ID范围，多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The resource types in scope. Multiple resource types are separated by commas (,)
ResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 资源类型范围，多个资源类型用半角逗号（,）分隔

AutoGroupingScopeCondition.description_en: The scope condition for automatic group transfer, which specifies the range of resources to be automatically transferred
AutoGroupingScopeCondition.description_zh: 自动转组范围条件，用于指定需要自动转组的资源范围

TargetResourceGroupCondition.description_en: The target resource group condition, which specifies the destination resource group for automatic grouping
TargetResourceGroupCondition.description_zh: 目标资源组条件，用于指定自动分组的目标资源组

RuleDesc.example: 带有标签 {"env": "online"} 和 {"project": "A"} 的资源转移到资源组rg-aek2********qcy

RuleName.example: A项目线上资源自动转组规则

RuleType.description_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
custom_condition: Transfer based on custom rules.
associated_transfer: Transfer associated resources together
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型。取值：
custom_condition：自定义规则转组。
associated_transfer：关联资源跟随转组
